title: The Last Kitchen Anew
premise: Mara Eastwick keeps her grandmother's lighthouse and writes novels no one reads, convinced second chances belong to people with better timing. When a blizzard strands her with Jonah Reyes—the rival baker whose family lease dispute threatens her beloved harbor bakery—and reveals that a decade-old betrayal was engineered by a third party, the two must decide whether the truth can thaw what pride froze. As the storm traps them in the keeper's cottage, they trade confessions, recipes, and the pieces of themselves they'd hidden. In the end, Mara chooses justice over safety, testifying against the developer with Jonah at her side, and the bakery—and her whole heart—reopens under new, shared terms.
about_author: Bram Galloway is the pen name of a former line cook who traded midnight prep shifts for midnight drafts, writing romance in the margins of recipe notebooks. Bram lives on a windswept coast, convinced that every kitchen is a confessional and every storm an editor.

chapters.title: Salt, Flour, and Weather Warnings
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Mara closes the harbor bakery for the season, fighting the lease notice she's hidden in a flour tin, when Jonah Reyes arrives to inspect the property for his family's development firm. A sudden blizzard strands them both at the lighthouse cottage. Emotional beat: wary friction crackling with unresolved attraction as the storm seals the doors.

chapters.title: What the Storm Makes Them Say
chapters.summary: Mara's POV, with a flashback to her twenties. Trapped without power, they cook by firelight and old grievances boil over—until Mara finds her grandmother's letters proving a third party, developer Victor Hale, forged the rivalry that split them apart years ago. Emotional beat: anger softening into stunned tenderness as the real villain surfaces.

chapters.title: The Recipe for Ruin
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. Jonah confronts his own complicity: he signed papers he never read, and Hale plans to raze the bakery within the week. He chooses to burn his bridge—emailing the forged documents to the press and to Mara—knowing it may cost him everything. Emotional beat: climax of sacrifice, as Jonah risks identity and inheritance for justice outside the law's slow machinery.

chapters.title: The Last Kitchen Anew
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Hale is exposed and the lease is voided; the town rallies to restore the bakery. Jonah asks for nothing but a chance to stay and knead dough beside her. Mara, who once lent pieces of her heart and kept the rest locked, hands over the whole of it. Emotional beat: resolution—belonging rebuilt, identity claimed, second chances finally well-timed.
